notes: The colophon names no persons. It contains only the chapter-end formula (Anekārthadhvanimañjarī, third adhyāya), the scribal formula "śrīr astu yādṛśī pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā...", and a gnomic verse (guṇā doṣāyante...). "Rāma rāma" is an invocation, not a person. The colophon has no date. The catalogue gives "SAM 1799" (era unspecified), which would be VS 1799 ≈ 1742 CE if VS, or ŚS ≈ 1877 CE if ŚS. I left the date fields empty because the colophon itself does not support either reading.
